name: my-ai-workday
description: Workspace dashboard and idea pipeline for an AI-assisted working day

scripts.install-app: npm run build && (osascript -e 'quit app "My Day"' -e 'quit app "My AI Workday"' >/dev/null 2>&1; pkill -x "My Day"; pkill -x "My AI Workday"; true) && rm -rf "/Applications/My Day.app" "/Applications/My AI Workday.app" && cp -R "release/mac-arm64/My AI Workday.app" /Applications/ && /usr/bin/xattr -cr "/Applications/My AI Workday.app"
